description: This file defines a class 'gitlab' that provides a PHP interface for interacting with the GitLab REST API. It includes methods for issue management, project retrieval, and configuration of cURL options for HTTP requests.

classes.name: gitlab
classes.description: A PHP class for interacting with the GitLab REST API, supporting issue management, project info, and custom configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the gitlab object with URL, API key, project ID, and optional configuration.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Sets up cURL options for HTTP communication with GitLab, including proxy configuration if provided.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a specific issue given its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue by its ID from GitLab.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves list of issues for the current project.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in GitLab with provided title and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note/comment to an existing issue.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects accessible with the given credentials.

methods.name: getProjectByIdentity
methods.description: Fetches project details by project ID or identifier.

methods.name: getIssueStatuses
methods.description: Method stub for getting issue statuses (not implemented).

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method for GET HTTP requests to GitLab API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs HTTP request and decodes JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Base method to send HTTP requests using cURL with various HTTP methods.
